trans-unit.source: Checking your session, then taking you back.
EN / VI: Switch language between English and Vietnamese
Return to your workspace to review evidence and make informed release decisions.
After sign-in, continue to your saved workspace destination. Access is checked before it opens.
After sign-in, continue to your workspace.
Private route details are not displayed on this sign-in page.
Your provider account is your only sign-in credential. Evidgate does not ask for a separate email or password.
Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
Your browser session may still be valid. Server sign-out is not available yet.
Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Choose a provider to try again.
Sign-in failed. Choose a provider to try again.
This project's runs, authoring and releases arrive with their own stories. For now this page shows the project the URL resolved to.
Manage organization membership. The server decides actual access.
Organization access will be revoked. Authored history stays attributed.
Select the organization roles for this member.
The server refuses to demote the last organization admin. Grant tenant_admin to another member first.
Organization roles are unavailable. Try again when the role catalogue is available.
The list now shows the server's current roles. The remaining changes have not been applied.
Role catalogue unavailable. Memberships remain visible.
Display only. The server decides actual access.
Permissions omitted because they are missing from the live catalogue:
Members and pending invitations will appear here.
The next members page could not be loaded. The members already shown are unchanged.
Use a wider screen to invite, edit or remove members.
No settings destinations are available with your permissions. Ask an administrator.
This tab arrives with its own feature story.
Flaky is a case label. It never overrides attempt #1 or the stored has_failures outcome.
This waiver does not change the stored outcome or decision.
Reload is explicit. Your draft is not merged or resubmitted automatically.
The current version could not be compared
The current version could not be reloaded
The server did not say how long to wait
Render-only examples of evidence, decisions and their independent states.
Completeness, outcome and decision are separate fields. Missing evidence never implies approval.
The draft stays local. Reload current compares a loaded example, not a live request.
Explicit retry requests in this example:
Current content appears only after a nonempty successful read.
Open the feature tree to inspect the cases awaiting evidence.
The request could not reach the server. Your evidence has not been replaced.
Attempt #1: the checkout button could not be found.
The declared producer has not supplied evidence.
Ask a project administrator for access to this workspace.
This page does not exist or you do not have access to it.
Organization setup will be available with onboarding.
We could not load your workspace. Try again.
The workspace is still unavailable. Try again later.
This screen arrives with its own feature story. Its route, permission guard and navigation entry are in place so the shell can be reviewed end to end.
Resume from server-confirmed resources. Viewing a step does not change your progress.
There is no next setup step.
This step is not available yet
Your setup progress is read from the server. Viewing a step does not complete it.
No setup resources have been created yet.
Resources could not be refreshed. Showing the last confirmed resources.
Activation details are unavailable with your current access.
Choose a name your team will recognise.
Use a short URL name, for example my-project.
Ask your organisation owner for permission to create projects.
The project could not be created
Choose one connection method. Next becomes available only after the server confirms a binding or token.
Set the one-time challenge as the repository variable EVIDGATE_BINDING_CHALLENGE. The binding becomes active after the first CI exchange; the browser never exchanges CI credentials.
In your workflow, grant permissions: id-token: write. Pass the GitHub OIDC JWT and EVIDGATE_BINDING_CHALLENGE to your CI-side Evidgate exchange. Keep the challenge out of workflow files and logs.
Enter a positive whole-number repository ID.
One per line, for example refs/heads/your-branch. Enter 1– patterns.
Enter between 1 and non-empty ref patterns.
One per line, for example owner/repo/.github/workflows/ci.yml@refs/heads/your-branch. Enter 1– refs.
Enter between 1 and non-empty workflow refs.
Ask your organisation owner for permission to create CI bindings.
Use an ingest token when OIDC is not available. Save the one-time value in your CI secret manager, never in source control.
Enter a token name between 1 and characters.
Ask your organisation owner for permission to create or rotate ingest tokens.
The previous token continues verifying until (UTC):
Shown only once. Save this value before leaving this step. If copying fails, select and copy the value manually.
The connection was saved, but progress could not be refreshed. Retry loading metadata; do not create the connection again.
It may have been saved. Reload the connection data before trying again.
A one-time value is shown. Save it before leaving this step.
Showing the first entries; more exist, so a newer entry may not appear here.
Token use is not a project-wide ingest timestamp. OIDC-only activity is not shown, and token-use timestamps are updated at most once every 60 seconds.
The token list is incomplete. The latest token use shown may be older than the newest use; an unlisted token may have been used more recently.
Only part of the credential list is shown. Health reflects the listed credentials; an unlisted credential may still be usable.
At least one listed credential is usable. This does not confirm a successful ingest.
Only tokens in their rotation overlap are usable. Update CI to use the replacement before the overlap ends.
No listed credential is usable yet. Run the first CI exchange to verify the pending binding.
No usable credential is shown, but the list is incomplete. Connection health cannot be determined from this list.
None of the listed credentials is usable. Create an ingest token or enable a CI binding.
No connection credentials are recorded. Create a CI binding or an ingest token.
Usable during the rotation overlap. Switch CI to the replacement token before it ends.
Not usable until the first CI exchange verifies this binding.
Not usable: the token has expired.
Not usable: the token has been revoked.
Not usable: the binding is disabled.
Not usable: the rotation overlap has ended. Use the replacement token.
Set EVIDGATE_API_URL and EVIDGATE_PROJECT as non-secret CI variables.
Inject EVIDGATE_INGEST_TOKEN from your CI masked secret store. Never paste its value here.
Pass the EVIDGATE_BINDING_CHALLENGE repository variable by name; keep its value out of this file.
Grant id-token: write in the CI job so the CLI can request GitHub OIDC credentials.
Create an ingest token first, then inject EVIDGATE_INGEST_TOKEN from your CI masked secret store.
Replace the API URL placeholder with your API root, without /v1. Run these commands with your CI variables and credentials injected. This snippet contains metadata only, not credentials.
Copy was unavailable. Select the commands above and copy them manually.
Platform staff access under support grant
Platform staff access (grant id not recorded on this row)
First rows exported — narrow the filter for a complete export.
Review organization activity and support access. Audit records cannot be edited here.
Enter times in your local time zone; results and exports use UTC.
Enter a valid time range with From no later than To.
Audit events will appear here when activity is recorded.
Clear or narrow the filters to review audit activity.
The next audit page could not be loaded. The rows already shown are unchanged.
Showing the newest rows. Narrow the filters to review older activity.
The previous invite token will stop working. Copy the new token and share it with the invitee securely.
The invite token will stop working. This person will not be able to accept the invitation.
Shown once. Copy this token now and share it securely with the invitee, who needs it to accept. If Copy fails, select and copy the value manually.
The invitation was created or renewed, but its token can no longer be shown. Use Resend on the member row to get a new one.
This value is shown only once. Store it securely and update your CI. If copying fails, select and copy the value manually before dismissing.
The previous token keeps working until
Inspect reference metadata and rotation timing. Current credential values cannot be fetched or displayed.
Ingest token references will appear here for the selected project.
No projects available in this organization.
The next page could not be loaded. References already shown are unchanged.
Rotation recorded. Update your downstream CI with the new credential and verify it there.
Use a wider screen to rotate credentials.
The rotation may have been applied. Reload the list and check the status before rotating again.
Inspect policy revisions and compare their fields. Open a revision using its identifier.
Inspection only on narrow screens. Use a wider screen to publish a revision.
No revision selected. Enter a revision ID to inspect its policy.
Revision bodies could not be loaded.
Select two revisions to compare their fields.
This comparison is truncated. Not all field differences are shown.
Review the JSON policy body before publishing. Publishing does not change the activation mode.
The policy body could not be loaded. Close and reopen to try again.
The policy body exceeds the 65536-byte limit.
The policy revisions could not be loaded.
Repository bindings and allowed CI references. Metadata only; bindings are managed during onboarding.
Waiting for the first CI exchange.
No CI bindings for this project. Bindings are created during onboarding.
You are not permitted to view CI bindings for this project.
CI bindings are unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
Review collection state. Open a run for its stored decision and evidence completeness.
State, decision and run scope filter loaded runs only. Ref name filters the server list. Load more to search older runs.
Runs will appear here when a producer creates them.
No matching runs in the loaded rows
These filters apply to loaded runs, not the entire project. Load more when available, or clear filters.
Automatic browsing paused. Load more to continue, or narrow the ref name.
Ref name not applied: use 1 to 255 characters with no control characters.
Enabling collection records a decision for every run of this project. It does not gate any merge yet.
Not gating yet. This policy runs in advisory mode, so Evidgate records what it would have decided and never blocks a merge.
Ask your release approver to enable collection for this project.
The confirmation may already be recorded. Retrying is safe: it reuses the same idempotency key.
This project now collects evidence in advisory mode.
This project was already enabled in advisory mode, so this confirmation changed nothing on the server.
Confirming activates the default advisory policy for this project. It can only replace a policy activated after this page read that the project had no activation.
The project's activation state could not be read with your permissions. Confirmation is disabled.
This project is enabled. This panel is built from the activation recorded on the server, so reloading the wizard shows the same state.
The activation could not be read. Reading it again is safe.
The activation could not be read
The server asked you to wait before reading the activation again: s left of the s it named.
Copy failed. Select and copy the full hash shown above.
This published revision is immutable and read-only.
Strategy is read-only in this view.
Strategy unavailable: this revision has an unrecognized shard strategy.
Case revisions by variant. Each populated cell shows its member identifier, requirement and ordinal.
Repeated variant members: ; the matrix keeps only the first member of each cell.
This revision has more cells than a matrix can show, so its members are listed as a flat table.
Each child member depends on the parent member shown beside it.
This revision has no members, so there is no composition matrix to display.
Reading the pinned members, variants and dependencies.
This revision does not exist or is not available in this project. Check the revision link.
You do not have permission to view this revision. Ask a project administrator for access.
The suite service is temporarily unavailable. Reload this page later.
Suite composition could not be loaded
The revision could not be read. Check your connection and reload this page.
The suite revision response does not include warning details.
No live evaluation recorded for this revision
This view stays pinned to the selected evidence revision.
You are viewing revision . The newest revision is .
Collection may still be in progress. No evidence verdict is inferred.
This revision is not in the loaded pages. Load older revisions to look for it.
Historical decision details are not available from this reference.
Collected and expected counts do not match.
The reported build does not match the manifest.
A reported result status is not recognized.
Evidence belongs to a stale producer epoch.
An expected test result is missing.
Viewing evidence revision . Newer revision is available.
No live evaluation is available yet.
Decision refresh failed. Previously loaded decision retained.
A shadow evaluation does not replace the live decision.
Live decision updated for evidence revision
This decision was evaluated at evidence revision while the selected evidence revision is .
Development only. Use the configured dev-login secret instead of a provider account.
Signing in and checking your session…
The dev-login secret is incorrect. Try again.
Dev sign-in is not enabled. Check the development server configuration.
The run list does not carry decisions. Open the run for its stored decision.
Collection is incomplete. Review the evidence panel for recorded missing reasons.
